title: Rone ke liye kaafi hai sajjad tera naam
body:
Rone ke liye kaafi hai Sajjad Tera naam
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad haye sajjad
Asir-e-bekara
bimar-e-na tawan
wo budha sa jawan
wo ghairat ka jahan
chala hai shamko
luta ke aashiyan
dikhane chal padha
raahe haq ka nishan
tha roya khun kyu
bimaar e sarbaan
bhare baazar me
bhare darbaar me
rahi hai berida
nabi ki betiyan
sajjad haye sajjad haye sajjad
<<MINI>>
Tu shahensha e dard hai,batla rahi hai shaam
